topic: Men's long jump world record holder
core_question: Who holds the current men's world record in the long jump? (secondary: In what year did World War I begin?)
answer_summary: The answer must name Mike Powell, who jumped 8.95 meters in 1991, as the current men's long jump world record holder.; after the topic shift: 1914, the year World War I began, following the assassination of Archduke Franz Ferdinand.
persona: impatient and curt; chatty and verbose
